metrics.formula: count of aspect 3-cliques containing at least one fixed relational or compound-condition pair
metrics.limit: Structural 3-clique intersection only; the degree-preserving null does not preserve typed aspect-family semantics.

rules: A metric is not an astrological strength score.
A low null probability under one control is not astrological validation.
Topic-routing permutations must use house-label-sensitive metrics; global basin concentration is invariant when only house labels are permuted.
Cross-layer network metrics hold the observed dispositor and condition layers fixed while rewiring only aspect connectivity.
